name: Border War
intro: Gunpowder infantry in a fictional border conflict. Muskets, bayonets, scouts, smoke and messengers; no radios, aircraft, modern weapons or magic. A volley, reload and short reposition can fit one turn; sustained sprinting and accurate fire cannot. Units are detachments, not individual characters. Cohesion and cover matter more than killing every opponent.

classes.name: Line detachment
classes.description: Twelve trained infantry. Strong when steady and mutually supporting; slow in dense woods.
classes.kit: Muskets, bayonets, cartridge pouches, signal flag. No artillery.

classes.name: Scout detachment
classes.description: Eight light infantry. Good at observation, dispersed movement and flanking; vulnerable to a formed assault.
classes.kit: Light muskets, blades, field glasses, whistles.

classes.name: Raider band
classes.description: Irregular infantry intent on seizing the road. Seek exposed flanks; fall back when badly outmatched.

terrain.name: Open water
terrain.note: Dropships may hover here. Impassable to ground units.

terrain.name: Wide water
terrain.note: Lakes and wide rivers. Impassable to ground units.

terrain.name: Beach
terrain.note: Embarkation point when adjacent to open water.

terrain.name: Dense urban
terrain.note: Short sight lines. Contacts are hard to detect.

terrain.name: Hills
terrain.note: Elevated. Good for observation and comms relays.

edges.name: River
edges.note: Runs along hex sides. Ground units cross only at a bridge or ford.

edges.name: Ridge
edges.note: Steep high ground. Ground units cross only at a pass.

edges.name: Wall or barricade
edges.note: Built obstacle. Engineers can breach it.
